summary: The diff modifies Hero.tsx to use the new spices/herbs flat-lay image as the hero background via the correct asset path '/assets/generated/hero-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg', while preserving Ken Burns animation, gradient overlays, text overlays, and CTA buttons. REQ-1 appears to be substantially implemented. However, the actual image file is not present in the diff (no added binary/asset files), and one additional overlay (amber tint gradient) appears to have been added beyond what was in the original component.

missing_requirements.requirement: The static asset file frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg must be present for the hero background image to render.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows no added files, meaning the image asset itself (hero-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg) is not included in the changeset. Without the actual image file in frontend/public/assets/generated/, the hero section cannot display the spices and herbs photo.

hallucinated_features.description: An extra warm amber tint overlay was added to the hero section (a diagonal linear-gradient with rgba(101,67,33,0.30) to complement the herbs and spices palette).
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly states 'Do not modify any hero text, overlays, animations, or CTA buttons — only swap the background image source.' Adding a new gradient overlay goes beyond swapping the background image source.
